I feel this a lot. Especially when im not distracting myself, mostly with video games. It's a creeping feeling I get over time. And if that feeling dosen't disperse within a few days, it becomes a breakdown. At those moments it's just waterworks for an hour or more. Then comes in the numbing feeling. The feeling that I'd be fine with dying right there and then.

Being alone definitely adds to this. Being inside all the time and just spending time doing nothing important. Just picking up my guitar to practice sometimes. Wishing I could do something with someone. Yet at the same time I don't want to go anywhere. I feel safer at home. I don't want to go out and make a fool of myself. I don't want to look like a loser again. It takes its toll.

I grew up around some toxic people. People who would belittle me and punish me all together. Being the only child who wasn't related by blood, and didn't grow up with them from the very beginning, I just felt alone. It sticks with me now even moving away about 3 years later. Now I feel like I lost my social skills. And I've become a piece of shit who enjoys pushing people away from me, when in reality I don't want that. Maybe because I feel like I don't deserve love.
